transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I need to speak to someone right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn’t replied in five days. This is not acceptable.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I’m very sorry. Can I take your name and project details?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sheetal Deshpande. My designer is Aryan. Flat in Viman Nagar — 2BHK. I’ve sent three messages and called twice.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sheetal, I’m getting this to our project team right now. Would you prefer to hold for two minutes, or should I have someone senior call you back within 15 minutes?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Callback. And I want it from Nikhil or a senior person — not just whoever picks up.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Noted. I’ll make sure of that.

transcript.speaker: note
transcript.text: Existing project complaint. Escalated to studio head immediately.
